tests/redis-cache-provider.test.tsRedisCacheProvider integration: raw key layout, SCAN batching, URL connections, lifecycleYes (auto-skips)
tests/pubsub-contract.test.tsFull PubSubProvider contract, run against both Memory and Redis backendsRedis suite auto-skips
tests/memory-pubsub.test.tsMemoryPubSubProvider unit tests: glob matching, fan-out, error isolation, prefix transparencyNo
tests/redis-pubsub.test.tsRedisPubSubProvider integration: real delivery, psubscribe, fan-out, shutdownYes (auto-skips)
tests/cache-plugin.test.tsCache plugin builders and the createCache() factoryNo
tests/pubsub-plugin.test.tsPub/Sub plugin builders and the createPubSub() factoryNo
tests/memory-subpath.spec.test.ts./memory subpath loads without evaluating ioredisNo
tests/memory-subpath.impl.test.ts./memory subpath re-export identity and plugin wiringNo

Running the Tests ​

ScriptCommandPurpose
test:fastvitest run --reporter=verboseUnit tier only — Redis suites self-skip
test:watchvitest watch --reporter=verboseWatch mode
test:coveragevitest run --coverageV8 coverage via @vitest/coverage-v8 (start Docker for full Redis coverage)
testdocker:down → docker:up → vitest run → docker:downFull suite with the complete Docker lifecycle
docker:up / docker:down / docker:logsdocker-compose -p webafx-cache -f ./docker/docker-compose${MODE}.yml ...Manage the redis-test container; MODE selects a compose variant

Docker Dependency ​

The Redis integration suites connect to dockerized Redis on port 6399 — the compose file maps the container there so it never clashes with a local Redis on 6379. docker:up starts the redis-test service and sleeps 5 seconds before Vitest runs; docker:down tears the container down with -v --remove-orphans. docker:logs streams the redis-test service log for debugging.

You never need to make Docker mandatory: every Redis suite probes availability first and self-skips when the container is down (see Integration Testing). That is why test:fast works with no infrastructure at all.

No custom Vitest configuration is required — tests live in tests/*.test.ts, run in the default Node environment, and Vitest's default 5-second per-test timeout is sufficient because the timing-sensitive suites use 1–3 second TTLs with explicit margins.

Required Imports ​

SymbolModuleUsed for
describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, beforeAll, vivitestSuite structure, assertions, lifecycle, spies and mocks
RedisioredisRedis availability probe and raw key inspection
CacheProvider, MemoryCacheProvider, RedisCacheProviderblendsdk/webafx-cacheCache suites
PubSubProvider, MemoryPubSubProvider, RedisPubSubProviderblendsdk/webafx-cachePub/Sub suites
